item.title: Unlocking the Full Potential: The Harmonious Dance of EF Core and SQL Server
item.description: Every tool possesses untapped potential, waiting to be discovered. Explore the poetic synchronization between EF Core and SQL Server, as they join forces to create the most elegant solutions. Let’s embark on a journey from understanding basic scaffolding to the intricacies of schema evolution and SQL debugging. It’s time to be inspired by the art of database craftsmanship.

item.title: Common mistakes in EF Core
item.description:
When JK worked with many different clients and projects, he frequently heard “EF Core is slow” or “We should do this in raw SQL” only to realize they haven’t used EF Core correctly.

JK will show you how to improve your EF Core statements as well as how various configurations impacts the performance and scalability of your application. You’ll be blown away at how small changes can significantly impact not only the performance but also stability of the application.
